# proxmox_cluster_node_remove (Resource)

Removes a node from the cluster configuration through `DELETE /cluster/config/nodes/{node}`. The local node cannot be removed through its own API: Proxmox answers 500 `Cannot delete myself` and the call becomes a no-op, so apply it against another node. The action is imperative: every change replaces the instance, destroy is a no-op, and the node itself is not powered off.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_cluster_node_remove" "old" {
  node     = "pve-old"
  triggers = { gen = "1" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node to remove. Changes require replacement.
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values that decide when to remove again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Node name.
